Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs, names, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL5104090. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, then to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5104090'. Return columns molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
